tree.title: EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT
tree.text:
EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT
This Employment Contract is made between TechNova Solutions SARL, Tunis, Tunisia (the "Employer"), and Ahmed Ben Ali, Tunis, Tunisia (the "Employee").

tree.title: 1. Position
tree.text:
1. Position
The Employee is hired as a Junior Software Developer. The Employee will develop and maintain software applications, assist with technical tasks, and perform other reasonable duties related to the position.

tree.title: 2. Start Date and Duration
tree.text:
2. Start Date and Duration
Employment begins on October 1, 2026 and is permanent, subject to the applicable employment laws.

tree.title: 3. Working Hours
tree.text:
3. Working Hours
The Employee will work 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, with a one-hour lunch break.

tree.title: 4. Salary
tree.text:
4. Salary
The Employee will receive a gross salary of 2,200 TND per month, paid by bank transfer at the end of each month.

tree.title: 5. Leave and Benefits
tree.text:
5. Leave and Benefits
The Employee will receive annual leave, public holidays, social security coverage, and other statutory benefits in accordance with applicable Tunisian law and company policy.

tree.title: 6. Confidentiality
tree.text:
6. Confidentiality
The Employee agrees to keep confidential all non-public information relating to the Employer, its clients, software, finances, and business operations.

tree.title: 7. Termination
tree.text:
7. Termination
Either party may terminate this contract in accordance with applicable Tunisian employment laws and required notice periods.

tree.title: 8. Governing Law
tree.text:
8. Governing Law
This contract shall be governed by the laws of Tunisia.
By signing below, both parties confirm that they have read, understood, and agreed to the terms of this contract.
